title: A phone screen under a microscope
alt: A phone screen magnified about two hundred times: a grid of tiny glowing rectangles on black, in columns. Thin green bars alternate with squarish orange-red blocks and taller blue blocks, so each colour of light comes from its own small spot.
author: Matthew Rollings at English Wikipedia
credit: Transferred from en.wikipedia to Commons by Wdwd using CommonsHelper.
description: Photo taken with a 200x digital microscope by Matthew Rollings [1]. It shows the RGB arrangement of the pixels on Google's Nexus One AMOLED screen with PenTile matrix pixel arrangement.
